title: Prepare and equilibrate pure polyarylate amorphous cell
action: Build an amorphous periodic cell of polyarylate chains (chemical structure per the paper) at a target density of ~1.18 g/cm³ using the Dreiding II force field. Perform equilibration (energy minimization, short NVT/NPT runs) to relax the structure.
description: Construction of the initial simulation cell and initial relaxation to obtain a well-equilibrated starting configuration for the pure matrix.

title: NPT MD simulation of pure polyarylate
action: Run NPT molecular dynamics on the equilibrated cell at 300 K and 1 atm with Dreiding II, sampling cell-parameter fluctuations and energies. Save trajectory with cell dimensions.
description: Production MD run to collect cell-parameter fluctuation data needed for elastic constant calculation.

title: Compute pure matrix elastic stiffness tensor and moduli
action: From the pure polyarylate MD trajectory, extract the cell-parameter fluctuation matrix ⟨ε_i ε_j⟩, compute the isothermal elastic stiffness tensor c_ij^T using c = (k_B T / V) ⟨ε ε⟩^{-1}, and derive isotropic moduli (E, G, B, ν, λ, μ). Write the stiffness tensor and all derived moduli to a JSON file.
description: Analysis step: compute fluctuation-based elastic constants and derived mechanical properties for the pure matrix.
output_schema: JSON object with keys: 'stiffness_tensor' (6x6 list of floats, in GPa), 'E' (tensile modulus in GPa), 'G' (shear modulus in GPa), 'B' (bulk modulus in GPa), 'nu' (Poisson ratio, dimensionless), 'lambda' (Lamé constant in GPa), 'mu' (shear modulus, same as G, in GPa).

title: Prepare and equilibrate reinforced amorphous cell (100 Å poly(p-phenylene) rod)
action: Construct a new amorphous periodic cell containing a single poly(p-phenylene) rod of length 100 Å aligned along the z‑axis (rod atoms placed once, then the flexible polyarylate chains are filled around it). Equilibrate using the same Dreiding II force field.
description: Generation of a cell with a rigid rod embedded in the polyarylate matrix.

title: NPT MD simulation of reinforced cell
action: Run NPT MD at 300 K and 1 atm on the reinforced cell, recording cell dimensions to capture the reduced fluctuations along the rod direction.
description: Production MD run for the reinforced system.

title: Compute reinforced matrix elastic stiffness tensor and directional moduli
action: From the reinforced cell trajectory, compute the stiffness tensor c_ij^T using the fluctuation formula. Extract the longitudinal tensile modulus E33 (along the rod, z‑direction) and the transverse modulus E11. Write the stiffness tensor and these moduli to a JSON file.
description: Analysis step: compute elastic constants and directional moduli for the reinforced system.
output_schema: JSON object with keys: 'stiffness_tensor' (6x6 list of floats, in GPa), 'E33' (tensile modulus along rod direction in GPa), 'E11' (transverse tensile modulus in GPa), 'G44' (shear modulus involving rod direction in GPa).
